title: Archnemesis decision (decisions/<id>.yaml): one architecture decision record

title.description: What was decided, in a line.

status.description: proposed: open. accepted: in force. rejected: considered and turned down. superseded: replaced (say by what in superseded_by).

affects.description: The objects it changes (ids); they show a badge linking here.

superseded_by.description: The decision that replaced this one (its file name, without .yaml).

text.description: The record, in markdown: context, the decision, consequences.
